discovery_notes: WDW 2024 open-edition pass; 24 WebSearch calls (shared search budget exhausted early), all search_snippet. Mostly Disney Pins Blog plus WDWNT. 2024 dated series spotted Dec 2023 but included as 2024 merchandise. Many pins sold at both DL and WDW. Festivals skew LR/LE; no festival OE found. Not covered: it's a small world OE, Disney Springs-specific OE, Festival of the Holidays, Pride. Figment April 2024 OE: DPB/WDWNT say 3 pins, MickeyBlog says 5 - kept separate, not merged. EPCOT 2024 mystery release month uncertain. Reseller-only facts (8-design dated mystery count) not recorded.
